scope: Key-path review of 39 published modules and benchmark; additional selected tooling paths. Not line-by-line or device performance acceptance.

findings.title: Nested apply misclassifies previous parent writes
findings.observed: Parent 0 to 1 then child to 2 fails with one conflict.
findings.expected: Sequential child apply succeeds; later parent changes still conflict.

findings.title: Derived upstream subscriptions outlive consumers
findings.expected: The last consumer releases upstream ownership.

findings.title: Throwing observer interrupts committed notification
findings.observed: Committed value is 1; the remaining observer receives zero notifications; retry conflicts.
findings.expected: Commit is terminal before callbacks and every affected observer is attempted.

findings.title: Same-document IME completion loses undo
findings.observed: Finishing composition with unchanged text leaves canUndo false.
findings.expected: Finalizing composition records one undo unit.

findings.title: Text history escapes snapshot rollback
findings.observed: Abandoning an edit restores empty text but leaves canUndo true.
findings.expected: Value and history roll back together.

findings.title: Resource image cache identity crosses incompatible hosts
findings.observed: Equal resource IDs and host-local revisions form equal shared cache keys.
findings.expected: Keys distinguish resource environments and preserve SDK signatures.

findings.title: Removed focus modifier leaves native flags
findings.observed: Modifier-only removal skips restoration of previously overridden focus flags.
findings.expected: Removal and disposal restore owned native properties.

findings.title: Overlay cleanup stops after a failing handle
findings.observed: First dismissal throws; the second entry remains active.
findings.expected: Attempt all cleanup and report collected failures.

findings.title: Child timeout does not bound descendants
findings.observed: A 150 ms timeout waits 3558 ms for inherited pipes.
findings.expected: Terminate the task process tree and bound completion.

findings.title: Stale frame dispatch survives cancellation
findings.observed: After cancellation, old queued work posts and renders one frame.

findings.title: Nullable drawing cache misses
findings.observed: The same null result is built twice for an equal key.
findings.expected: A successfully cached null is a cache hit.
